name: Sprayscourge
description: Loose the first star from the left court of the hand while the right waits in reserve.

name: Chime Centerhole
description: Stand utterly still as in a court at judgment and let the field measure the target.

name: Spray Reckoning
description: Rake a spoke from the left hand across the face while the right hand guards the throat.

name: Sprayglimmer
description: Pivot on the rear foot into the corner of the foe's blind side and square up again.

name: Facet Cornerpoint
description: Throw one star from each hand along separate lines that agree on a single mark.

name: Obdurate Spoke
description: Cross the held stars in an X over the forearm and slide an incoming blade off both edges.

name: Granite Edgeface
description: Step forward through the line of a thrust as the star leaves the hand behind it.

name: Hoarfrost Rimpoint
description: Two stars arc apart and swing back together so the foe's single dodge saves him from neither.

name: Ponderous Peppering
description: Cast stars in a ring around a foe and draw the qi field taut so their flats close together.

name: Facet Hail
description: Two stars reach one mark in the same instant and pass through whatever guard stands between.

name: Facet Sprinkle
description: Open from a high shoulder set and let the star fall flat into the hollow of the target.

name: Whizwrath
description: Drop low and drag a held spoke along the shin of a foe standing on bare ground.

name: Facet Thinplate
description: Set the elbow high like a folded wing and snap the star out over it.

name: Waning Hub
description: Keep a slow breath and watch the whole rim of the ground for any shift of cover.

name: Torrent Flatpoint
description: Walk heel to toe with the weight carried high so the ground gives no warning.

name: Gnashing Tippoint
description: Throw up and out so the star climbs on its spin and drops on a foe behind cover.

name: Torrent Bladeface
description: Turn the held star to catch a blow and send its force rolling around the rim and away.

name: Murkspoke
description: Cast a shadow with a raised star while the real throw leaves from the other hand.

name: Spraywrath
description: Pour stars from the high hand in a steady cascade to fill the hollow where the foe hides.

name: Ruinous Centerhole
description: Hurl a star steeply downward and drive it point first into a target standing low in the hollow.

name: Rimpoint Hardihood
description: Cast stars in a wide ring with points inward and bind it with qi to guard the center.

name: Peppering Ruin
description: A great overhead throw splits into many stars that fall together across the hollow below.

name: Hoarfrost Whiz
description: Throw with an open wide arm like a river opening into the delta.

name: Blaze Flatpoint
description: Draw a spoke across the target in a small rippling zigzag that confuses the parry.

name: Phantom Edgeface
description: Step along the bank of a stream or ditch with a light foot and a ready hand.

name: Chimetooth
description: Throw from two angles so the stars meet at the target like rivers at a confluence.

name: Chime Cornerpoint
description: Spin the star in a small circle before the body and send a thrust curling aside.

name: Hub Ruin
description: Let the field carry a slow star down its channel and bring it to rest at the mark.

name: Silt Scatter
description: Pour out stars in a rising surge that floods the ground low and wide.

name: Deed Spoke
description: Hide a ground sweep of stars under a thin layer of debris so a charging foe is dragged down.

name: Sprayglare
description: Cross the gap between two banks in a single blur and loose a star at the landing.

name: Chime Spray
description: Draw two equal stars together and release them with the same motion of both wrists.

name: Resurgent Tippoint
description: Count each pace of the foe aloud and keep the beat for the next paired throw.

name: Granite Bladeface
description: Hook one spoke over the sword arm and another under it and pull in opposite directions.

name: Whizglimmer
description: Match each advance of the foe with a half step back so the distance stays fixed.

name: Torrent Hub
description: Cross both wrists to catch a downward blow and turn it aside along the forearms.

name: Hubscourge
description: Throw with both hands in the same instant along lines that mirror each other across the foe.

name: Hubvalor
description: Meet two attackers with a star held to each side and strike back only when one gaps.

name: Intent Sprinkle
description: Throw a matched pair on every beat of the count in an even stream that pins the target.

name: Nova Whiz
description: One star splits a raised guard while the matching star follows through the opening it made.

name: Scatter Valor
description: Cast two orbiting stars around a foe and close the field so he is held within the circle.

name: Hellish Scatter
description: Two stars fall in perfect step from the same height and punch one hole through plate.

name: Spoke Wrath
description: One hawk's star leaves the hand first as a scout that shows the way for the rest.

name: Vigilant Flatpoint
description: Count the stars aloft by feel and mark which of the flock still holds its line.

name: Punishing Sprinkle
description: Draw the thin edge of a spoke across the throat of a strap or the back of a hand.

name: Might Hail
description: Hop lightly from one footing to the next like a hawk between perches.

name: Aegis Tippoint
description: Fold both forearms across the chest like wings and take a strike on the folded edges.

name: Hourspray
description: Scatter stars in every direction at once so the flock seems to come from the whole sky.

name: Decimating Bladeface
description: Hurl the star along a steep line like a diving hawk onto a mark below.

name: Mangling Whiz
description: Beat both arms like wings and loose a star on every downstroke without pause.

name: Unbowed Rimpoint
description: Spin in place with the stars held out like feathers so any strike is thrown aside.

name: Mayhem Spray
description: The whole flock of stars falls on the target zone in one swift plunging rush.

name: Lethal Thinplate
description: Spread stars in a lattice above the field and tie them with qi so none can pass below.

name: Decimating Peppering
description: A single qi-hard star dives at one plate of the armor and punches clean through it.

name: Mayhem Edgeface
description: Throw such a mass of stars at the sky that the ground beneath falls under their shadow.

name: Wrathful Cornerpoint
description: Throw several light stars quickly on the rain track so they patter across the target.

name: Lacerating Centerhole
description: Throw few but heavy stars on the hail track so each lands with a hard knock.

name: Granite Hail
description: Shuffle the feet flat over slick stone without lifting them so the stance never breaks.

name: Ironspoke
description: Let a spoke trail down the target in a slow drip of a cut and withdraw.

name: Hailscourge
description: Send a light star and a heavy star down their tracks so both arrive in the same storm.

name: Hubdurance
description: Throw a thin veil of stars before the body to knock down arrows and darts.

name: Nova Thinplate
description: Throw the heaviest star with a hammering overhand stroke to dent plate.

name: Slagtooth
description: Hurl heavy stars high so they drop in a rattling hailstorm across the ground.

name: Silt Edgeface
description: Lay a line of stars along the rain track that springs upward when a foe steps across.

name: Intentspoke
description: Run the light track and the heavy track together in one long storm that never pauses.

name: Rumble Hub
description: Throw the first star as a sworn promise to its mark and do not take it back.

name: Flatpoint Premonition
description: Speak the oath on the breath and sight along the line the star must keep.

name: Sanguine Whiz
description: Slash with a held spoke at the same instant the wind shifts to hide the stroke.

name: Rumble Tippoint
description: Hold a straight sworn line and throw the star down it so it neither drifts nor tumbles.

name: Vanishing Rimpoint
description: Slide over the flat hard ground in a long low step that keeps the hands steady.

name: Equipoise Bladeface
description: Turn a star edge-on to take a blade and keep the oath of the guard unbroken.

name: Hailwrath
description: Keep a volley flowing on a sworn count so the stream does not stop until the oath ends.

name: Hoarfrost Spray
description: Throw a straight row of stars through the cloak and sleeve of a foe and into the ground.

name: Tempered Peppering
description: The sworn star flies true through every obstacle in the line and ends the oath at the mark.

name: Hubhavoc
description: Flick a star out into the crosswind so it begins its curve before it leaves the hand.

name: Mightwhiz
description: Drag a spoke across the foe as the wind pulls him slightly off his guard.

name: Perceptive Spoke
description: Count the gusts as they come and learn the length of the lull between them.

name: Gustspray
description: Lean into the wind and take a slanting step that keeps the body low and steady.

name: Equipoise Cornerpoint
description: Whip the cloak edge across a blade and let the wind throw its folds over the cut.

name: Centerhole Ruin
description: Throw into the shear of two winds so the star turns sharply near the end.

name: Gnashing Hail
description: Wait for the lull between gusts and loose the star in its exact still moment.

name: Thinplate Hardihood
description: Throw a pinning star along the crosswind and catch a flapping cloak to a stake.

name: Might Sprinkle
description: Lean with a gust of wind and let it carry the body a pace clear of a strike.

name: Thinplate Spine
description: Cast stars into the crosswind and fix them in a drifting net that slows anyone who enters.

name: Hourtooth
description: Pour stars along the front edge of a gale so the line of foes cannot step out.

name: Meteoric Sprinkle
description: Ride the crosswind in one blur across the field and pierce the foe from the flank.

name: Blaze Whiz
description: Take a bearing along a distant ridge line and throw exactly along it.

name: Glintwhiz
description: Crouch behind a low ridge of rock and throw from the shoulder with the head below the line.

name: Cornerpoint Reckoning
description: Hook a spoke around a foe's ankle as he climbs over the ridge line.

name: Healing Rimpoint
description: Hold the breath and the bearing together until the line to the target is certain.

name: Facet Centerhole
description: Skim a star along the very top of a ridge so it clears the slope on either side.

name: Glint Flatpoint
description: Throw down into a gully so the star falls steeply on a foe in the shadowed cut.

name: Intentspray
description: Throw once then read where the first star landed and correct the bearing for a second.

name: Hoarfrost Scatter
description: Gather qi and throw one star across the whole gap between two ridges.

name: Thorntooth
description: Throw a row of stars along one bearing so a foe moving on it is pinned in turn.

name: Corroding Bladeface
description: One star flies along the held bearing to the very hair of the line and pierces the mark.

name: Blaze Tippoint
description: Under a clear sky throw a star level and long with no cover to hide its path.

name: Rumble Scatter
description: Speak the oath of the open sky aloud and throw at the last word.

name: Pitiless Peppering
description: Rake a spoke across the target on the edge of a passing cloud shadow.

name: Unerring Edgeface
description: Count breaths while watching the sky for a hawk or shadow that signals a foe.

name: Silttooth
description: Take a long stride over open ground that closes or opens the range in one pace.

name: Toothscourge
description: Skim the star low through the grass in the first light so it arrives unseen.

name: Murktooth
description: Open the hand wide and turn a strike aside with the flat of the palm and star.

name: Rampaging Hub
description: Swear to a count of throws and loose them evenly until the count is done.

name: Titanic Hub
description: Hold the star aloft in the open air while qi gathers then send it down in one long throw.

name: Slag Hail
description: Throw stars outward in every direction under the open sky with nothing to stop the spread.

name: Evergreen Bladeface
description: Catch thrown stars and darts in the qi field and send each straight back to its thrower.

name: Chime Rimpoint
description: Release the star at the peak of a sworn gust so the wind adds its push.

name: Galvanizing Thinplate
description: Breathe with the wind and find the steady lane where a star will hold its line.

name: Sanguine Edgeface
description: Slash at the foe in the instant a gust tears his guard open.

name: Spokeflash
description: Skip across the ground on the push of a gust and land ready to throw.

name: Thorn Cornerpoint
description: Brace into the wind with the forearm raised and let it push a blow off line.

name: Scatter Reckoning
description: Wrap the star in a thin skin of wind so it bends around cover in a long arc.

name: Charter Sprinkle
description: Fan a spread of stars into the gale so they sweep a wide front.

name: Thorn Hail
description: Throw a star through a cloak billowing in the gust and pin it to a post.

name: Impervious Tippoint
description: Turn to face the wind and parry with a star while the gust pushes the blow wide.

name: Devastating Centerhole
description: Send a qi-hardened star down a straight gale line at the gap beneath a helm.

name: Toothspine
description: Hang stars in the lane of wind in a net that tears at anything driven through it.

name: Blazetooth
description: Throw stars into a whirling gust so a ring of points spins around the target zone.

name: Wrathful Spray
description: Open the whole sworn gale at once and ride it with a ceaseless stream of stars.

name: Spokehavoc
description: Stand at the edge and throw straight out across the open drop.

name: Granite Whiz
description: Walk the lip of the drop and slash with a held spoke at any foe who nears.

name: Chime Tippoint
description: Scan the whole length of the edge with the field and mark where the ground crumbles.

name: Rumble Flatpoint
description: Skip the star off the stone lip in a low bounce that rises under the foe's guard.

name: Adamantine Edgeface
description: Meet a cut with the star and let the updraft at the lip lift the blade away.

name: Sprayblink
description: Hop back along the edge and loose a star the instant both feet are planted.

name: Rimpoint Wrath
description: Throw in one high gathered arc from one edge of the plateau to the foe on the next.

name: Charter Peppering
description: Rain stars along the lip in the gale so any foe that stands up is struck down.

name: Rumble Spoke
description: Blur along the lip of the plateau and loose a star from a place the foe did not expect.
